predecessors.name: Sultanate of Zanzibar
predecessors.text: the Sultan's 'strip along the Kenyan coast', whose sovereignty ceased 'simultaneously with independence for Kenya'

ledger.x: 12 December 1963: Kenya becomes independent of the United Kingdom as a dominion.
12 December 1963: the Sultan's coastal strip becomes part of Kenya.
December 1963: the Shifta War over the Northern Frontier District begins.
October 1967: the Shifta War ends in a stalemate and Kenya keeps the Northern Frontier District.

wars.name: Shifta War
wars.outcome: Inconclusive (infobox): 'a stalemate developed'; no territory changed hands and 'the state's territorial status quo would be maintained'.

certainty.note: Inherited colonial boundaries; the Northern Frontier District frontier with Somalia was contested by arms from 1963 to 1967 and Britain kept the status quo ('no altering Kenya's frontier without the decision of the new Kenyan Government'…
